# `curdate`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the current date at the start of query evaluation. All calls of curdate within the same query return the same value.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
curdate()
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 0 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- curdate, example 1
> SELECT curdate();
2026-11-07
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.4.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
